system.description: For those with nothing better to wear.
Once per map, as a Bonus Action, you may heal 2d6 + Mgt HP and restore 1d4 Stn. At 10th level, gain another 1d6 healing on your HP roll. At 20th level, gain another 1d4 on your Stn recovery roll.

As a Bonus Action, push an adjacent unit, moving them 1 square forward. If the targeted unit is not allied to you, you must first pass an Athletics check (DC 3 + target's Bld).

The target must be the same size as the user. If the target is airborne, the user must be able to reach it in melee.
